Recipe Book screenshot OCR regression fixtures

These losslessly curated crops were supplied by a project contributor for local,
offline regression testing. PNG ancillary metadata and unrelated screen content
were removed before the fixtures were added. The fixtures are not copied into the
Black Spirit Hub application, installer, or release package.

Black Desert and its interface, item artwork, names, and related marks are the
property of Pearl Abyss or their respective owners. Their appearance in this
test-only fixture set does not imply affiliation or endorsement.
